notes.title: Niraya of ■■ Demo ver.1.0.1
notes.content:
Update Notes – Niraya of ■■ Demo ver.1.0.1

The demo version of Niraya of ■■ has been updated to ver.1.0.1.
The changes are as follows:

[Bug Fixes]
[list]
[*] Under certain conditions, progressing to the corridor where the “Mine Shaft Survey Report” is placed would cause the game to become unplayable.
This issue has been resolved by removing an invisible obstruction that was preventing progress.
Additionally, save data affected by this issue has been adjusted so that progress can resume correctly upon loading.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support of Niraya of ■■.
